visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight brown hair, wearing a white silky robe, stands against a plain neutral background. She smiles at the camera, touching her cheek with her index finger. (2) A horizontal split screen appears, showing extreme close-ups of the woman's cheek; the top panel is dull and the bottom panel is glowing and hydrated. (3) The woman holds two skincare products: a tall black bottle with gold accents and a dark blue jar with a gold lid. White sparkling graphics overlay the frame. (4) Close-up shot of the black bottle with the label 'Eclat d'Or' and transparent windows showing small golden spheres inside. (5) A hand pumps the black bottle, dispensing a small amount of translucent yellow liquid containing golden beads onto a palm. (6) Fingers rub the liquid on the back of a hand, showing its smooth texture as it dissolves into a clear fluid. (7) The woman applies the serum to her face in a medium close-up, gently patting her skin which appears very reflective and bright. (8) A sudden cut shows the woman outdoors on a boat; she is wearing a yellow top, smiling at the camera with the blue ocean and green hills in the background under bright sunlight. (9) Back indoors, a close-up shows the blue jar labeled 'KORENA Radiant Caviar & Truffle Gold Eternal Cream' next to a small gold spatula. (10) A finger scoops out some thick white cream from the blue jar and applies it to her face, followed by her massaging it into her cheeks with both hands. (11) A screen filled with small boxes containing social media comments, screenshots, and product photos appears, representing user reviews. (12) A gold trophy graphic and a large circular badge with the text '85%' are shown over images of the products. (13) The woman holds both products again, winking and smiling brightly at the camera. (14) The video ends with a dark blue screen featuring the white logo of a plant icon and the brand name 'KORENA'.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long dark brown hair, wearing a white silk-like robe in indoor scenes and a yellow strap top in the outdoor boat scene.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary background is a blurry neutral indoor setting. A brief outdoor scene features a bright blue ocean with distant green mountains under a clear sky. Several segments use graphic overlays and digital screen captures of social media content.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks in a bright, energetic Mandarin tone, introducing a skincare secret over a driving, upbeat electronic pop track with a steady 4/4 beat. The vocal is crisp and clear, center-mixed. (2) A subtle digital 'pop' sound effect coincides with a visual change. The music maintains a constant volume as a backing bed. (3) A soft 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the narration shifts to describing product ingredients. The speaker's pitch remains high and enthusiastic. (4) As the benefits are listed, the speaker emphasizes certain words with increased vocal arousal. A twinkling magic-style SFX is heard briefly when '發光' is mentioned. (5) The narration continues seamlessly over the looping background music, maintaining a professional but very friendly tone throughout the demonstration of product textures and usage. (6) A sharp transition sound effect marks the shift to the review and sales data montage. The music gains a slightly more percussive feel. (7) Final summary statements are delivered with a warm, conclusive tone. The music swells slightly in the final two seconds before a clean hard cut to silence at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Evidence -> Product Demonstration -> Social Proof -> Results -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and sell the KORENA brand caviar skincare set by demonstrating its efficacy, highlighting unique ingredients and technology, and providing social proof through user reviews and sales statistics.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly presents the brand name, products, and benefits, and the video ends with a brand logo screen.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-frequency cuts and text overlays typical of social media marketing. The combination of personal vlog-style demonstration and corporate sales data is designed to build both trust and urgency.
